# Draft:Viking Growth

----
Viking Growth is a Norwegian venture and growth investment firm focused on business-to-business (B2B) software companies in the Nordic region. The firm has been covered in independent Norwegian business and technology media for its investments, exits, and participation in industry consolidations.
History and overview
Viking Growth was founded in 2001 and initially operated as a general venture capital investor before gradually focusing on growth-stage B2B software companies. The firm is headquartered in Trondheim, Norway, and provides capital alongside operational and strategic support to portfolio companies.
Investments and exits
In 2025, Viking Growth announced an investment commitment of more than 100 million Norwegian kroner toward Nordic technology companies, according to financial newspaper Finansavisen.
The same year, Viking Growth exited the software company Xait through a sale to the private equity firm Main Capital Partners. Finansavisen reported that Xait experienced substantial growth during Viking Growth’s ownership period prior to the transaction.
Strategic partnerships and mergers
In 2026, Viking Growth participated in the creation of a larger HR technology company through a merger involving portfolio companies, in cooperation with investment firm Verdane. The transaction was described in Norwegian business media as a significant consolidation within the Nordic HR technology sector.
Investment approach
Viking Growth typically invests as a minority shareholder and works closely with founders and management teams on strategy, pricing, sales execution, and international expansion. The firm has described its model as combining financial investment with hands-on operational support.
Media coverage
Viking Growth’s activities have been reported by national financial media such as Finansavisen, as well as technology-focused publications including Shifter and TechWatch, which have covered the firm’s investments, exits, and participation in mergers and acquisitions within the Nordic technology sector.
